title: Geologic Map of the Fair Bluff Quadrangle, Dillon and Horry Counties, South Carolina
citation: Pierce, C.N., Wykel, C.A., and Payeur, M.L., 2024, Geologic Map of the Fair Bluff Quadrangle, Dillon and Horry Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report 259, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Map sheet with a text layer (page 1); pages 2-4 are an unrelated FGDC symbol-style note bundled in the download, not South Carolina geology, and were not recorded. Pairing of map symbols with descriptions checked on a page image of the legend. Ages of QPftu and QPt-I/II/III read from the Correlation of Map Units on a page image (inferred); Qfp spans the Holocene/Pleistocene boundary on the chart and has no age recorded. Terrace-plain elevation ranges recorded as unit-top surfaces with no datum printed and no location beyond the map. Six SCDNR well-log locations (FAIR-100 to FAIR-105) are labelled on the map face; no logs printed. North Carolina part not mapped. Contact symbol legend-only. SUBSURFACE: none beyond the recorded values.
